name: Holy Wood (In the Shadow of the Valley of Death)

podcast.body: Released in 2000, this album is the first chronological part of Manson's conceptual autobiography trilogy, though it was released last. It criticizes America's love of guns, the use of God, and the role of government. At its center is a character named Adam Cadmon, initially an almost pure human being whose perfection is gradually eroded by the world, leading to corruption, rot, and disillusionment. "And finally, there's Holly Wood from 2000, which criticizes America's love of guns, the use of God and the role of government."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
